tools.name: fs__edit
tools.description: Apply content-anchored (hashline) edits to a file. Anchored edits target a LINE#HASH anchor copied verbatim from read output — e.g. {"op":"replace","pos":"11#KT","lines":[...]}. The hash is validated against the file's current content; if it changed since you read it the edit is REJECTED with fresh anchors to retry (never silently relocated). "lines" must be literal file content with NO "LINE#HASH:" or diff "+/-" prefixes. Ops: replace (pos, optional end for a range), append (after pos / EOF), prepend (before pos / BOF), and replace_text (find an EXACTLY UNIQUE substring "text" and swap it for "replacement"; rejected if missing or non-unique). Anchored edits apply bottom-up; replace_text cannot be mixed with anchored ops in one call.

tools.name: fs__glob
tools.description: Find files matching a glob pattern. Walks recursively from path (default cwd).

tools.name: fs__grep
tools.description: Search file contents with regex. Walks recursively from path (default cwd).

tools.name: fs__ls
tools.description: List a directory with structured metadata: name, type (file/dir/symlink), size, permissions, mtime. Returns the formatted ls output.

tools.name: fs__read
tools.description: Read a file. Each line is prefixed "LINE#HASH:" (1-indexed line number + 2-char content hash); copy those LINE#HASH anchors into the edit tool's pos/end. Optional offset/length for raw partial byte reads (no prefixes).

tools.name: fs__write
tools.description: Write content to a file (creates or truncates).

tools.name: readctx__read
tools.description: Read a file with a window of context around a target line.
